entities.summary: K. Usha was an Indian judge who served as Chief Justice of the Kerala High Court. She was the first female judge on the High Court. She advocated for women's rights and the elimination of all forms of discrimination. Usha served as president of the Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal.
